about: Vitruvian Manager's sources, version 1 (PRP-SCHOLAR-USP-DESIGN.md 5.1, stage S1): each with its citation, a short name for legends, the version VM holds, its licence, its address, when VM read it, and its terms as read: 'host' (VM may host its values, with the credit it asks) or 'cite-only' (VM may cite a figure and link to it, but hosts none of its rows). termsUrl, termsQuote and termsRead record where the terms were read, the sentence that decides, and when; credit is the credit the source asks for, in its words. A careful record of the terms as read, not legal advice. The cite-only entries agree with integration/scripts/cite-only.mjs (a test checks it both ways); stage S2a moves the tests onto this file and adds a source per column and row.

sources.inputs: EN.POP.DNST rests on FAO's land area (its Source field names FAO). FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/, read 20 November 2026): "Unless specified otherwise in their metadata or webpage, all datasets disseminated through FAO corporate statistical databases ... are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0)"; they may be adapted and re-disseminated, but "shall not be used for or in conjunction with the promotion of a commercial enterprise" nor to suggest FAO's endorsement. VM uses them for neither. The FAOSTAT land-use domain's own metadata could not be read (its interface answered "Missing Authorization Header"). Every series VM holds that rests on FAO's land area is treated alike, on FAO's own terms.
sources.credit: World Bank, World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)
sources.changes: Each economy's values kept as the World Bank gives them; the aggregates left out; drawn on Natural Earth's countries of today by ISO 3166 alpha-3 code (omni/scripts/build-wb.mjs).
sources.originators: An originator's own terms decide over the World Bank's label (MP-11). The International Energy Agency's terms (https://www.iea.org/terms, read 20 November 2026) list "Standalone datasets, data explorers and databases" as content not made available under CC BY 4.0, and its terms for that material (https://www.iea.org/terms/terms-of-use-for-non-cc-material) bar "making more than 5 (five) raw data points from the Non-CC Material, whether or not aggregated, accessible for download". So EG.USE.PCAP.KG.OE, EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS and EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5, which name the IEA among their sources though their metadata reads CC BY-4.0, are not hosted (omni/scripts/build-wb.mjs, BARRED). The terms of IHME (EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3), ITU (IT.NET.USER.ZS, IT.CEL.SETS.P2) and the UN Population Division (SP.POP.*, SP.DYN.*) could not be read on 20 November 2026 (their pages refused an automated reader or gave no licence) and stay to be checked.
